note: Synthetic matrix only. Actors: anonymous, owner (resource author), stranger (authenticated non-party), seller (offer author), moderator, admin. Guards combine actor, ownership, state, relationship, and purpose; role labels never replace them (INV-05).

matrix.refusal: none; nonexistent id -> 404 without disclosing existence reasons

matrix.operation: POST request draft / publish / revise / renew / close / remove
matrix.owner: allow when eligible (quotas, deadline, revision rules)
matrix.moderator: deny forbidden_owner (staff do not own user resources)
matrix.refusal: 403 forbidden_owner or 409/422 state codes; no other owner's data in the response

matrix.operation: POST offer submit / resubmit / edit / withdraw
matrix.seller: allow on own single slot per cycle when eligible
matrix.owner: deny forbidden_role (self-offer refused, no slot created)
matrix.refusal: stranger sees nothing of competing offers (AC-19)

matrix.owner: allow (all own offers with seller display names)
matrix.seller: deny: only own offer via seller-scoped read
matrix.refusal: competing prices and buyer phone inaccessible to sellers (INV-30, INV-31, AC-19)

matrix.owner: allow when author, offer live and current, parties eligible, no block/restriction (INV-27, INV-28)
matrix.stranger: deny forbidden_owner regardless of seller or professional status (AC-22)
matrix.refusal: generic refusal; no phone destination; no-store response

matrix.owner: allow own request outcomes; notices visible only to intended account
matrix.refusal: terminal history preserved; no cross-account disclosure

matrix.owner: allow against eligible counterpart/content (own safety actions)
matrix.refusal: reporter identity never disclosed to the reported party (INV-31)

matrix.operation: Staff restrict / restore / prohibit-class / appeal review
matrix.refusal: paid status never overrides a restriction; lifting one restriction overrides nothing else (INV-38, AC-43)
